summary: Reproduced both independent-review counterexamples at candidate f2e033dc00060fbab489fe5225dfb8fcdf061385. The correction preserves exact client user/tool content for the normal chat-template render, does not rewrite text-only requests, and retains a separate loader-safe render only for Qwen-family requests with an actual image attachment.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate content, independent assertions failed for text-only content and for mixed image user/tool content because the chat template received spaced replacements rather than the literal client spelling. The candidate's own attachment-cardinality behavior passed.

After correction, four tests and nine subtests passed: exact text-only preservation, exact user/tool content at the normal template boundary, one authoritative loader marker for one real PNG, real image decoding, complete/partial parser boundaries, and malformed reference schema validation.
160 tests and 92 subtests passed across serving-chat rendering, multimodal bad-input behavior, and actual image decoding.
One AMD Instinct MI350X under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2 computed [[1,2],[3,4]] squared and exactly matched the independent CPU reference [[7,10],[15,22]]. This establishes GPU availability only.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-d5c061fb759f/evidence/gpu-check.txt records the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X and exact reference equality. The parser regression itself is CPU-only.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3.8-27B weights and architecture were unavailable, so full OpenAI HTTP serving and semantic inference were not run.

The loader-facing render intentionally neutralizes client-authored complete markers so the legacy regex scanner cannot consume them as attachments; the exact content is preserved at the normal chat-template boundary and text-only requests are unchanged.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot exercise or qualify Qwen-VL prompt rendering or multimodal processing.
Malformed attachment references were validated at the Pydantic request boundary rather than through a live model server.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
